history: Games where you escape a crowd of robots by tricking them into crashing into each other are among the oldest computer games. The idea seems to have started at a college computer center in the early 1970s; nobody knows who wrote the first one. A version called Chase was printed in a computer magazine in 1976, and type-in copies spread through the home-computer magazines that followed. In the 1980s the game came with the operating systems of university workstations and reached the first desktop computers with a mouse, where small versions became a favorite way to pass a few minutes between real work. deleks is a new version of that old game, written for phones and tablets.
